==Description==
The Fake Strange Keycard is an item that can be found Anywhere during April Fools 2026

==Behavior==
It will place itself Anywhere in the room, being disguised as the Keycard Needed to enter [[Section E]], if the player tries to pick the Fake Strange Keycard up, they will be met with a jumpscare before being killed

==Strategies & Tips==
Avoid clicking to pick up items without looking to see if its not the keycard. And if you see it, just don't pick it up.
